meta.name: roadmap-planning
meta.description: Plan a strategic roadmap across prioritization, epic definition, stakeholder alignment, and sequencing. Use when turning strategy into a release plan that teams can execute.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将战略转化为可执行的发布计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把战略拆解成团队能执行的发布计划
copy.tagline_en: Turn strategy into an executable release plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn strategy into a release plan that teams can execute

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成从收集业务目标、客户问题到定义史诗、排序优先级、规划发布节奏的完整路线图制定流程，最终输出一份按季度或 Now/Next/Later 组织的战略路线图。
howto.when: 当你需要将战略转化为可执行的发布计划时触发，例如在季度或半年度规划周期中，或从零开始构建路线图时。

say.text: 我有 15 个竞争性项目，需要制定一个能让高管批准的 Q2 路线图。
say.note: Claude 会引导你进行优先级排序和利益相关者对齐。

say.text: 我们正在规划 6 个月的产品路线图，需要跨 3 个团队安排工作顺序。
say.note: Claude 会帮你定义史诗、估算工作量并生成依赖图。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a structured process to collect business goals, customer problems, define epics, prioritize, sequence releases, and produce a strategic roadmap organized by quarters or Now/Next/Later.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to turn strategy into an executable release plan, such as during quarterly or half-year planning cycles, or when building a roadmap from scratch.

say_en.text: Plan a 2-quarter roadmap for our mobile app: here are our 3 OKRs and 12 candidate initiatives.
I have 15 competing initiatives and need a Q2 roadmap my exec team will approve.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through prioritization and stakeholder alignment.

say_en.text: We're planning a 6-month product roadmap and need to sequence work across 3 teams.
say_en.note: Claude helps define epics, estimate effort, and generate a dependency map.
